channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Ancient skeletons from Vietnam challenge syphilis origins
item.description: Remains from 3,500 years ago suggest diseases like yaws may have been transmitted from mother to child, a route often overlooked in historical studies.

item.title: Adult brain shows greater self-repair capacity than assumed
item.description: Research in mice reveals a specialized group of support cells that may enable the adult brain to repair itself more effectively than previously thought.

item.title: Researchers identify brain rhythm that may enhance Parkinson's therapy
item.description: A study has identified a brain network and its electrical rhythm that seem to drive the benefits of deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's disease.

item.title: Starlink satellites used as a novel tool to probe Earth's upper atmosphere
item.description: Researchers have developed a method to map a hard-to-observe part of the upper atmosphere using orbital data from Starlink satellites.
